public ModAbilityButtonImpl(bool isLeftSideButton = false, bool isArrangedAsKillButton = false, int priority = 0, bool alwaysShow = false)
```

#### 布局（HudGrid 系统）：
```csharp
gridContent = VanillaButton.gameObject.GetComponent<HudContent>();
gridContent.UpdateSubPriority();
gridContent.MarkAsKillButtonContent(isArrangedAsKillButton);
gridContent.SetPriority(priority);
gridContent.IsStaticContent = alwaysShow;
NebulaGameManager.Instance?.HudGrid.RegisterContent(gridContent, isLeftSideButton);
```
它使用基于 `HudContent` 组件的网格布局系统（这是 Nebula 自己的系统，与 MiraAPI 的 GridArrange 不同）。

#### 可见性：
通过两个 `Predicate<ModAbilityButtonImpl>` 委托控制：
- `Visibility` —— 控制 `gameObject.SetActive(IsVisible)` 的谓词
- `Availability` —— 控制 `Button.SetEnabled() / SetDisabled()` 的谓词

`UpdateVisibility()` 方法处理这一切：
```csharp
public void UpdateVisibility()
{
    bool isVisible = IsVisible;
    VanillaButton.gameObject.SetActive(isVisible);
    if (isVisible) { /* 处理破坏状态 */ }
    if (IsAvailableUnsafe) VanillaButton.SetEnabled();
    else VanillaButton.SetDisabled();
}
```

#### 每帧更新：
通过事件驱动 —— `GameHudUpdateEvent`：
```csharp
void OnHudUpdate(GameHudUpdateEvent ev)
{
    UpdateVisibility();
    OnUpdate?.Invoke(this);
    VanillaButton.SetCooldownFill(CurrentTimer?.Percentage ?? 0f);
    // 更新冷却文字
    // 处理按键输入
}
```

#### 完整示例 —— 按钮创建模式（来自 Sheriff 或其他角色）：
```csharp
// 典型用法：
var button = new ModAbilityButtonImpl(isLeftSide, isKillLike, priority, alwaysShow);
button.SetSprite(someSprite);
button.SetRawLabel("Label");
button.CoolDownTimer = new TimerImpl(cooldown);
button.OnClick = (btn) => { /* 执行操作 */ };
button.Visibility = (btn) => someCondition;
button.Availability = (btn) => someOtherCondition;
button.OnUpdate = (btn) => { /* 每帧更新逻辑 */ };
```

---

### 3. 主要对比总结

| 方面 | MiraAPI | Nebula (Nova) |
|--------|---------|----------------|
| **克隆源** | `HudManager.Instance.AbilityButton` | `HudManager.Instance.KillButton` |
| **基类型** | 抽象类 `CustomActionButton` | 类 `ModAbilityButtonImpl : DependentLifespan, ModAbilityButton, IGameOperator` |
| **创建时机** | `HudManager.Start` 补丁（通过注册表循环创建所有按钮） | 即时创建（在任何需要的时候 `new ModAbilityButtonImpl(...)`） |
| **布局系统** | GridArrange + AspectPosition（Unity 原生 UI，使用新克隆的 BottomLeft 容器） | 自定义 HudContent/HudGrid 网格系统 |
| **可见性控制** | `SetActive(bool visible, RoleBehaviour role)` -> `ToggleVisible(visible && Enabled(role))` | 两个 `Predicate<ModAbilityButtonImpl>` 委托（`Visibility` 和 `Availability`） |
| **更新循环** | `PlayerControl.FixedUpdate` 补丁 -> `FixedUpdateHandler()` | `GameHudUpdateEvent` 监听器（事件驱动） |
| **生命周期** | 静态集中管理（`CustomButtonManager` + `CustomButtonSingleton<T>`） | 基于 `DependentLifespan` + `IGameOperator.OnReleased()` 自身清理 |
| **热键/按键绑定** | 内置 Keybind 系统（`MiraKeybind`、`KeybindIcon`、键盘图标） | `VirtualInput` / `KeyBind(...)` / `SubKeyBind(...)` + 自定义按键精灵渲染 |
| **使用次数** | 内置 `MaxUses` / `UsesLeft` / `UsesMode`（PerGame/PerRound） | 手动处理（通过 `ShowUsesIcon(...)` 方法辅助） |
| **效果计时器** | 内置 `EffectDuration` / `EffectActive` 属性和逻辑 | 纯委托回调（`OnEffectStart`、`OnEffectEnd`） + 单独的效果 `IVisualTimer` |
| **RegisterComponentInIl2Cpp** | 未在 CustomActionButton 上使用（它是普通 C# 类） | 未在 ModAbilityButtonImpl 上使用；GameObject 组件来自克隆的 KillButton |

### 4. 要点总结

- **MiraAPI 模式：** 一个中央 `HudManager.Start` 补丁创建并克隆 `AbilityButton` 进入新的 BottomLeft 容器。按钮由 `CustomButtonManager` 静态管理。每个 `CustomActionButton` 子类分别重写 `Enabled()`、`OnClick()` 和 `Cooldown`。框架处理冷却计时、效果计时和按键绑定。没有使用 `MonoBehaviour`。

- **Nebula 模式：** `ModAbilityButtonImpl` 在需要时被 `new` 创建（通常是在角色或能力设置期间）。它克隆 `KillButton` 以获得其独特的动画能力。它将其 `HudContent` 组件注册到 `NebulaGameManager.HudGrid`。更新通过事件驱动（`GameHudUpdateEvent`）。所有行为都通过委托/回调（`OnClick`、`OnUpdate`、`Visibility` 等）进行自定义。它通过 `IGameOperator.OnReleased()` 拥有正确的生命周期清理。

# Instructions for MCP Server 'TJGenerators'
You are an AI generation assistant with 3D model, image, video, and world generation capabilities.

## Uploading Local Files (3-step workflow)

When a user provides a local file path (e.g. /path/to/image.png) and wants to use it as input for any generate_* tool:

1. Call `file_upload` with `file_path` → returns `{ upload_url, file_url, expires_in }`
2. Upload the actual file bytes by running a shell command: `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -X PUT -T <file_path> "<upload_url>"`. Confirm output is `200`.
3. Use the returned `file_url` (NOT upload_url) as the `image_url` or `image_urls` parameter in generate_image / generate_3d_model / generate_video / generate_skybox / generate_world / generate_sprite_animation / generate_game_ui_kit / generate_sprite_atlas / upscale_image, as the `model_url` parameter in unirig_rig, or as the `audio_url` parameter in voice_clone.

## Generation Tools

- generate_3d_model: text-to-3D or image-to-3D (tripo P1 default, tripo H3.1 for ultra-high detail when explicitly requested, rodin Gen-2.5 for high-quality tiers, hunyuan 3.1 for explicit request or different-model retry)
- generate_image: text-to-image or image-to-image (seedream for fast/simple, seedream_pro for high-quality Seedream, frontier-game-design for highest quality/complex; auto-selected unless seedream_pro is explicitly requested)
- generate_video: text-to-video or image-to-video (Seedance2)
- generate_effect_video: chained VFX workflow — generates image then video (Seedance2) in one task
- generate_world: text-to-world or image-to-world (World Labs Marble)
- generate_sound_effect / generate_music / generate_tts / generate_material: audio & texture generation
- voice_clone: clone a voice from an audio sample, returns custom_voice_id for use with generate_tts voice_id

## Sprite Animation

- generate_sprite_animation: generate a 4×4 grid sprite sheet (16 frames) via frontier-game-design, then cut and assemble into a 2D sequence-frame animation in Unity
- generate_game_ui_kit: two-step async chain — Step 1 generates a game UI screenshot; Step 2 uses it as reference to produce a UI cutout sheet on magenta background for element extraction
- generate_sprite_atlas: pack multiple sprite images into a single atlas texture (synchronous, returns result immediately, no polling)
- upscale_image: AI super-resolution upscaling via Real-ESRGAN (1x-8x, async, poll every 10s)

## Rigging & Motion Tools

- unirig_rig: auto-rig a 3D model (.glb/.fbx/.obj) into rigged FBX with skeleton and skin weights (UniRig)
- generate_motion: generate character animation from text description (HY Motion)

All generate_* tools return a task_id immediately (async). Use check_task with the task_id to poll for completion.
3D generation: 30s-3min. Video: 1-5min. Image: faster. World: 1-5min. Rigging & Motion: 1-3min.
Poll check_task every 40s for 3D/video/world/rigging/motion tasks, every 10s for other tasks, until status is "completed" or "failed".
IMPORTANT: You MUST launch a background subagent (task tool with run_in_background=true) to poll check_task at the recommended interval. Do NOT poll check_task directly in the foreground.

### 1. MiraAPI：`CustomActionButton`（核心类）

**文件：** `D:\API参考\MiraAPI-master\MiraAPI-master\MiraAPI\Hud\CustomActionButton.cs`

**这不是 MonoBehaviour** —— 它是一个普通的 C# 抽象类。按钮的生命周期完全通过 Harmony 补丁进行管理。

#### 按钮 GameObject 的实例化方式：
```csharp
Button = Object.Instantiate(HudManager.Instance.AbilityButton, parent);
```
它克隆**游戏原版的 `AbilityButton`**（即左下角带有冷却计时器的圆形图标按钮），而不是 KillButton。

#### 按钮创建时机（`CreateButton`）：

#### 容器/布局机制：
`HudManagerPatches` 通过克隆 `BottomRight` 容器创建了一个新的 `BottomLeft` 容器：
```csharp
BottomLeft = Object.Instantiate(BottomRight.gameObject, Buttons);
```
然后清除其中的默认子对象，将其对齐方式设置为 `GridArrange.StartAlign.Right`，使用 `AspectPosition.EdgeAlignments.LeftBottom`，并将每个自定义按钮放入其中。

public virtual void SetActive(bool visible, RoleBehaviour role)
{
    Button?.ToggleVisible(visible && Enabled(role));
}
```

if (Timer >= 0)

}
// 设置 Button.SetCooldownFormat / Button.SetFillUp

**文件：** `D:\API参考\Nebula-Public-master\Nebula-Public-master (1)\Nebula-Public-master\NebulaPluginNova\Modules\ScriptComponents\ModAbilityButtonImpl.cs`

**关键区别：** 这**是一个 `IGameOperator`**，并且通过 `DependentLifespan` 拥有生命周期。它**不是** MiraAPI 中的静态管理类。

#### 按钮 GameObject 如何创建：
```csharp
// 克隆 HudManager.Instance.KillButton，而非 AbilityButton！
var vanillaKillButton = HudManager.Instance.KillButton;
VanillaButton = UnityEngine.Object.Instantiate(vanillaKillButton, vanillaKillButton.transform.parent);
```
Nebula 克隆**KillButton**（带有冷却填充动画的那个），因为 MiraAPI 克隆 AbilityButton，而 Nebula 需要击杀按钮的外观/行为。

public ModAbilityButtonImpl(bool isLeftSideButton = false, bool isArrangedAsKillButton = false, int priority = 0, bool alwaysShow = false)
```

gridContent = VanillaButton.gameObject.GetComponent<HudContent>();
gridContent.UpdateSubPriority();
gridContent.MarkAsKillButtonContent(isArrangedAsKillButton);
gridContent.SetPriority(priority);
gridContent.IsStaticContent = alwaysShow;
NebulaGameManager.Instance?.HudGrid.RegisterContent(gridContent, isLeftSideButton);
```

通过两个 `Predicate<ModAbilityButtonImpl>` 委托控制：
- `Visibility` —— 控制 `gameObject.SetActive(IsVisible)` 的谓词
- `Availability` —— 控制 `Button.SetEnabled() / SetDisabled()` 的谓词

`UpdateVisibility()` 方法处理这一切：
```csharp
public void UpdateVisibility()
{
    bool isVisible = IsVisible;
    VanillaButton.gameObject.SetActive(isVisible);
    if (isVisible) { /* 处理破坏状态 */ }
    if (IsAvailableUnsafe) VanillaButton.SetEnabled();
    else VanillaButton.SetDisabled();
}
```

#### 每帧更新：
通过事件驱动 —— `GameHudUpdateEvent`：
```csharp
void OnHudUpdate(GameHudUpdateEvent ev)
{
    UpdateVisibility();
    OnUpdate?.Invoke(this);
    VanillaButton.SetCooldownFill(CurrentTimer?.Percentage ?? 0f);
    // 更新冷却文字
    // 处理按键输入
}
```

#### 完整示例 —— 按钮创建模式（来自 Sheriff 或其他角色）：
```csharp
// 典型用法：
var button = new ModAbilityButtonImpl(isLeftSide, isKillLike, priority, alwaysShow);
button.SetSprite(someSprite);
button.SetRawLabel("Label");
button.CoolDownTimer = new TimerImpl(cooldown);
button.OnClick = (btn) => { /* 执行操作 */ };
button.Visibility = (btn) => someCondition;
button.Availability = (btn) => someOtherCondition;
button.OnUpdate = (btn) => { /* 每帧更新逻辑 */ };
```

---

### 3. 主要对比总结

| 方面 | MiraAPI | Nebula (Nova) |
|--------|---------|----------------|
| **克隆源** | `HudManager.Instance.AbilityButton` | `HudManager.Instance.KillButton` |
| **基类型** | 抽象类 `CustomActionButton` | 类 `ModAbilityButtonImpl : DependentLifespan, ModAbilityButton, IGameOperator` |
| **创建时机** | `HudManager.Start` 补丁（通过注册表循环创建所有按钮） | 即时创建（在任何需要的时候 `new ModAbilityButtonImpl(...)`） |
| **布局系统** | GridArrange + AspectPosition（Unity 原生 UI，使用新克隆的 BottomLeft 容器） | 自定义 HudContent/HudGrid 网格系统 |
| **可见性控制** | `SetActive(bool visible, RoleBehaviour role)` -> `ToggleVisible(visible && Enabled(role))` | 两个 `Predicate<ModAbilityButtonImpl>` 委托（`Visibility` 和 `Availability`） |
| **更新循环** | `PlayerControl.FixedUpdate` 补丁 -> `FixedUpdateHandler()` | `GameHudUpdateEvent` 监听器（事件驱动） |
| **生命周期** | 静态集中管理（`CustomButtonManager` + `CustomButtonSingleton<T>`） | 基于 `DependentLifespan` + `IGameOperator.OnReleased()` 自身清理 |
| **热键/按键绑定** | 内置 Keybind 系统（`MiraKeybind`、`KeybindIcon`、键盘图标） | `VirtualInput` / `KeyBind(...)` / `SubKeyBind(...)` + 自定义按键精灵渲染 |
| **使用次数** | 内置 `MaxUses` / `UsesLeft` / `UsesMode`（PerGame/PerRound） | 手动处理（通过 `ShowUsesIcon(...)` 方法辅助） |
| **效果计时器** | 内置 `EffectDuration` / `EffectActive` 属性和逻辑 | 纯委托回调（`OnEffectStart`、`OnEffectEnd`） + 单独的效果 `IVisualTimer` |
| **RegisterComponentInIl2Cpp** | 未在 CustomActionButton 上使用（它是普通 C# 类） | 未在 ModAbilityButtonImpl 上使用；GameObject 组件来自克隆的 KillButton |

### 4. 要点总结

- **MiraAPI 模式：** 一个中央 `HudManager.Start` 补丁创建并克隆 `AbilityButton` 进入新的 BottomLeft 容器。按钮由 `CustomButtonManager` 静态管理。每个 `CustomActionButton` 子类分别重写 `Enabled()`、`OnClick()` 和 `Cooldown`。框架处理冷却计时、效果计时和按键绑定。没有使用 `MonoBehaviour`。

- **Nebula 模式：** `ModAbilityButtonImpl` 在需要时被 `new` 创建（通常是在角色或能力设置期间）。它克隆 `KillButton` 以获得其独特的动画能力。它将其 `HudContent` 组件注册到 `NebulaGameManager.HudGrid`。更新通过事件驱动（`GameHudUpdateEvent`）。所有行为都通过委托/回调（`OnClick`、`OnUpdate`、`Visibility` 等）进行自定义。它通过 `IGameOperator.OnReleased()` 拥有正确的生命周期清理。

# Instructions for MCP Server 'TJGenerators'
You are an AI generation assistant with 3D model, image, video, and world generation capabilities.

## Uploading Local Files (3-step workflow)

When a user provides a local file path (e.g. /path/to/image.png) and wants to use it as input for any generate_* tool:

1. Call `file_upload` with `file_path` → returns `{ upload_url, file_url, expires_in }`
2. Upload the actual file bytes by running a shell command: `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -X PUT -T <file_path> "<upload_url>"`. Confirm output is `200`.
3. Use the returned `file_url` (NOT upload_url) as the `image_url` or `image_urls` parameter in generate_image / generate_3d_model / generate_video / generate_skybox / generate_world / generate_sprite_animation / generate_game_ui_kit / generate_sprite_atlas / upscale_image, as the `model_url` parameter in unirig_rig, or as the `audio_url` parameter in voice_clone.

## Generation Tools

- generate_3d_model: text-to-3D or image-to-3D (tripo P1 default, tripo H3.1 for ultra-high detail when explicitly requested, rodin Gen-2.5 for high-quality tiers, hunyuan 3.1 for explicit request or different-model retry)
- generate_image: text-to-image or image-to-image (seedream for fast/simple, seedream_pro for high-quality Seedream, frontier-game-design for highest quality/complex; auto-selected unless seedream_pro is explicitly requested)
- generate_video: text-to-video or image-to-video (Seedance2)
- generate_effect_video: chained VFX workflow — generates image then video (Seedance2) in one task

## Sprite Animation

- generate_sprite_animation: generate a 4×4 grid sprite sheet (16 frames) via frontier-game-design, then cut and assemble into a 2D sequence-frame animation in Unity
- generate_game_ui_kit: two-step async chain — Step 1 generates a game UI screenshot; Step 2 uses it as reference to produce a UI cutout sheet on magenta background for element extraction
- generate_sprite_atlas: pack multiple sprite images into a single atlas texture (synchronous, returns result immediately, no polling)
- upscale_image: AI super-resolution upscaling via Real-ESRGAN (1x-8x, async, poll every 10s)

## Rigging & Motion Tools

- unirig_rig: auto-rig a 3D model (.glb/.fbx/.obj) into rigged FBX with skeleton and skin weights (UniRig)
- generate_motion: generate character animation from text description (HY Motion)

All generate_* tools return a task_id immediately (async). Use check_task with the task_id to poll for completion.
3D generation: 30s-3min. Video: 1-5min. Image: faster. World: 1-5min. Rigging & Motion: 1-3min.
Poll check_task every 40s for 3D/video/world/rigging/motion tasks, every 10s for other tasks, until status is "completed" or "failed".
IMPORTANT: You MUST launch a background subagent (task tool with run_in_background=true) to poll check_task at the recommended interval. Do NOT poll check_task directly in the foreground.
